classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that the longest rod is the diagonal of an axial rectangle with sides equal to the cylinder's diameter and height.

content.prompt: Calculate the length of the longest rod that can fit inside this cylinder with a diameter of 10 cm and a height of 15 cm. Round to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Upright cylinder with a rod extending from the lower-left rim to the opposite upper-right rim. Decorative bottom-face shading omitted.
spec.mathematics: The rod is the hypotenuse of an axial right triangle with perpendicular sides 10 cm and 15 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Rod and its label only; dimensions remain in the prompt.

answer.worked:
The axial right triangle has perpendicular sides equal to the diameter and height.
$$\begin{aligned}L^2&=10^2+15^2\\L&=\sqrt{325}\\L&\approx18.0\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
